needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path away from traffic.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side of the road to provide a safe pedestrian path away from traffic.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at the middle of the signalised crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait on wide roads.
Install dropped kerbs at both ends of the crossing to allow wheelchair users and pedestrians with mobility aids to cross safely.
Install street lighting along the urban road to improve visibility for drivers and pedestrians, especially in the wet conditions observed.
